up: List all distinct compounds from the ChEMBL database that are referenced in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5606458. For each compound, return its ChEMBL ID, its preferred name (if available from molecule_dictionary), and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures). The compounds must be linked to the document through the compound_records table (using doc_id from docs). Ensure the results are distinct over the compound ChEMBL ID to avoid duplicates if a compound appears multiple times in the same document. Do not apply any additional filters.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5606458';
